_path_note: Both intake paths (form-based: IntakePage.tsx, conversational: /intake/chat) produce this schema. The Builder cannot distinguish which path was used.
_for_llm: Read aegis_intake_v10_complete_spec.md fully before populating any field. This schema feeds an autonomous AI trading pipeline. What you write here directly determines what strategies are built and deployed with real capital. Read mandate_priority_hierarchy before any decision requiring trade-offs. Read filing_notes LAST.
_builder_note: Tier 1 fields are mathematical gates enforced by pipeline code. No AI agent overrides them. Tier 2 fields are investment policy context — read as a portfolio manager reads a client brief. Tier 2-Hard = Tier 2 fields marked 'immovable' in mandate_priority_hierarchy.preference_flexibility. These are inviolable within their pipeline stage (post-Tier-1-filtering) but are NOT Tier 1 filters — they apply at a different stage. Do not collapse them.

mandate_identification._note: Read before interpreting any other section. aegis_capital_as_pct_of_total_liquid_net_worth is the most important contextual field in this section — it determines whether downstream concentration limits are appropriate.
mandate_identification._investor_sophistication_note: Set first. Gates conditional field complexity throughout the form. retail_novice = simplified field sets. professional = full field set, technical language.

capital_structure._note: All Tier 1 fields enforced mechanically. existing_holdings is ticker list only — no quantity, no cost basis. Both max_single_position_pct and max_single_position_usd enforced simultaneously; the more restrictive applies.
capital_structure._reserved_cash_pct_note: Minimum cash buffer never deployed. System never deploys more than (100 - reserved_cash_pct)% of capital.
capital_structure._max_deployed_pct_note: Maximum % of investable_capital in live positions simultaneously. Distinct from reserved_cash_pct — accounts for pending orders and unsettled trades.
capital_structure._max_leverage_ratio_note: Active only if leverage_permitted = true. Gross exposure / capital ceiling. Excluded from enforcement if leverage_permitted = false.
capital_structure._existing_holdings_note: Tickers the user currently holds outside Aegis. Ticker list only — no quantity, no cost basis (those are portfolio management fields, not intake fields). Purpose: portfolio-level correlation awareness. If user holds 35% of net worth in Healthcare outside Aegis, Aegis's own sector concentration limits alone are insufficient context.
capital_structure._tickers_never_touch_note: Absolute unconditional exclusions enforced before any other logic. No override permitted.

tier_1_risk_constraints._note: The seven-field minimum risk set. Each addresses a distinct failure mode. All required.
tier_1_risk_constraints._max_portfolio_drawdown_pct_note: THE foundational risk input. Builder derives portfolio volatility target via risk-constrained Kelly logic assuming conservative baseline Sharpe of 0.4-0.6 for pre-deployment strategies. Derivation documented in filing_notes.volatility_target_derivation and updated as live performance accumulates.
tier_1_risk_constraints._max_daily_loss_pct_note: Daily circuit breaker. Reference point: portfolio value at market open for that trading day (starting-of-day NAV). If intraday P&L falls below (-1 * max_daily_loss_pct)% of starting-of-day NAV: halt all new position-building for the remainder of that day. Existing positions continue normal exit logic. Resets at next market open. Distinct from max_portfolio_drawdown_pct (cumulative) vs this (daily).
tier_1_risk_constraints._drawdown_breach_protocol_note: REQUIRED. Mandate cannot lock if null. Executed immediately when max_portfolio_drawdown_pct is hit.
tier_1_risk_constraints._max_single_position_pct_note: Percentage ceiling per name. Enforced simultaneously with max_single_position_usd. The more restrictive (binding) limit applies.
tier_1_risk_constraints._max_single_position_usd_note: Absolute dollar ceiling per name. Required alongside max_single_position_pct. Percentage alone is insufficient for large accounts: 5% of $2M in a $1M ADV stock = $100K position = 10% market impact, eroding the strategy edge. Binding rule: whichever of pct or usd is more restrictive applies.
tier_1_risk_constraints._max_sector_concentration_pct_note: Maximum capital weight in any single GICS sector simultaneously across all live positions. Post-catalyst strategies generate correlated sector signals during earnings seasons and FDA decision weeks.
tier_1_risk_constraints._max_concurrent_live_strategies_note: Operational safeguard AND stress-scenario protection. Covariance matrix manages correlation under normal conditions. This field provides structural protection when correlations spike to ~1.0 during market stress — a scenario the covariance matrix systematically underestimates from historical data. NOT redundant with the covariance matrix: complementary.
tier_1_risk_constraints._max_position_as_pct_of_adv_note: Maximum position size as % of the asset's 20-day average daily volume. Prevents market impact from eroding theoretical edge. Empirically validated range: 1-5% of ADV. Default: 3%.

tier_2_risk_context._note: Multi-dimensional. Do not reduce to a single label. Each sub-field drives a different calibration decision. regret_asymmetry has the single largest impact on exit rule design — weight it most heavily.

regret_asymmetry._type_note: HIGHEST IMPACT FIELD. loss_regret_dominant: enforce strict time-based exits; auto-liquidate at horizon midpoint percentage (magnitude-scaled). miss_regret_dominant: trailing volatility stops; full anomaly window. balanced: hybrid. See enforcement spec Part 7.1.

tier_2_risk_context._target_portfolio_beta_note: Target market beta for this mandate. 0 = market neutral. 1 = market-matching. Interacts with mandate_identification.portfolio_beta_existing to define what Aegis should add.

return_mandate._note: ALL fields advisory. Returns are outputs, not constraints. target_annual_return_pct is ADVISORY ONLY — explicitly labeled as such in the UI. target_win_rate_pct is ELIMINATED from this schema — win rate is an output of edge distribution, not a tunable input. Removed from v9.
return_mandate._target_annual_return_pct_note: ADVISORY ONLY. Builder uses to calibrate signal selection aggressiveness. NOT a hard optimization target. Sharpe feasibility check at confirmation flags if implied_sharpe > 1.5 (warning) or > 2.0 (blocking).

return_character._smoothness_ui_note: UI must show plain-language descriptions: smooth_and_consistent = 'Smaller, more frequent gains. Lower month-to-month volatility. Fewer large wins.' lumpy_and_high = 'Larger, less frequent gains. Some months flat or negative. Wins are larger when they come.'

return_mandate._expectation_calibration_note: Set to true only after user has reviewed and acknowledged filing_notes.realistic_performance_range at confirmation step. Mandate cannot lock if false. Timestamp stored in filing_notes.expectation_calibration_presented_at.

tier_1_hard_filters._note: Applied as database query parameters before signal generation. Strict exclusions enforced before any other logic runs.
tier_1_hard_filters._min_avg_daily_volume_note: Hard liquidity gate. Recommended minimum: 1000000. Empirically validated threshold for baseline tradeability in momentum strategies.
tier_1_hard_filters._price_min_note: Anti-penny-stock gate. Market manipulation and spread quality gate — not a liquidity proxy. Recommended: 1.00. Sub-$1 stocks disproportionately subject to dynamics that contaminate momentum signals.
tier_1_hard_filters._restrict_note: If true: sectors_of_interest enforced as hard filter. If false: sectors_of_interest is a Tier 2 preference weight only.
tier_1_hard_filters._sectors_of_interest_tier_note: Tier 1 only if restrict_to_sectors_of_interest = true. Otherwise Tier 2.

tier_2_context._sector_reasoning_note: WHY these sectors — the specific investment thesis, what the user knows about these markets. Informs sub-sector prioritization, adjacent sector signal handling, and regime-dependent weighting. Not decorative despite not changing the hard filter logic.

fundamental_screens._note: Fundamental screens interact directly with catalyst_types. Profitability screens applied to biotech catalyst types produce an empty universe — 94%+ of PDUFA candidates are pre-revenue. Use applies_to_catalyst_types to restrict screens to compatible catalyst types. System generates compatibility_warnings at validate step.
fundamental_screens._fundamental_screens_enabled_note: If false, entire fundamental_screens sub-section is skipped in Builder logic.

_screen_schema._applies_to_note: Options: 'all' | 'pead_only' | 'non_biotech_only' | array of specific catalyst_type enum values. Critical field — allows profitability screens to apply to PEAD while biotech catalyst types are unfiltered.

fundamental_screens._compatibility_warnings_note: System-generated at section validation. Not user input. Lists conflicts between screens and selected catalyst types in strategy_mandate.

strategy_mandate._catalyst_types_note: Most consequential user decision in this system. Must be explicit structured opt-in. Never inferred from prose.
strategy_mandate._horizon_allocation_note: Weights must sum to 1.0. Directly dictates Builder's selection of drift windows and exit trigger optimization.

tier_2_strategy_context._regime_universe_pairs_note: CREATION RULE: Generate ONLY from explicitly linked user preferences. Never infer. If user explicitly links a market condition to an asset class AND strategy type, create the pair. Otherwise leave empty.
tier_2_strategy_context._entry_philosophy_note: High-signal for experienced users. Respect strong views here over system defaults.
tier_2_strategy_context._exit_philosophy_note: Respect strong user views over system defaults. Interacts with regret_asymmetry.

tier_1_operational_constraints._note: available_windows is Tier 1 — hard operational filter on strategy types, not a soft preference. Promoted from v9 Tier 2. A strategy requiring execution outside these windows will never be acted on and must not be generated.
tier_1_operational_constraints._available_windows_note: Builder hard-excludes any strategy type requiring execution outside these windows.
tier_1_operational_constraints._max_execution_latency_note: At >= 120 minutes: strategies requiring tight entry windows are hard-excluded. Directly determines entry range width in generated strategies.
tier_1_operational_constraints._automation_level_note: fully_automated is NOT a valid value until the pipeline supports execution without manual Signal Card confirmation. Do not add it to the enum until that capability exists. fully_manual requires wider entry windows and simpler signal structures.

behavioral_profile._note: Every field in this section has a specific, parametric enforcement mechanism documented in aegis_intake_v10_complete_spec.md Part 7. Fields without defined enforcement are decorative — v10 does not have decorative fields. See spec for full algorithmic mappings.

regret_asymmetry._builder_enforcement: See spec Part 7.1. loss_regret_dominant → time-based exit at horizon midpoint (magnitude-scaled). miss_regret_dominant → trailing volatility stop, full anomaly window. balanced → hybrid.

disposition_effect_tendency._builder_enforcement: See spec Part 7.2. strong → mandatory minimum holding period on profitable positions before profit-taking exit signals are honored. Calculated as round(bucket.min_days * 0.5).

behavioral_profile._builder_enforcement: See spec Part 7.3. Calibrates stop loss distance: standard = 2.0x ATR, elevated = 1.5x ATR + 15% position size reduction, severe = 1.0x ATR + 25% position size reduction + signal threshold elevation.

overtrading_tendency._builder_enforcement: See spec Part 7.4. frequent → signal threshold elevated to top 20th percentile + 48-hour minimum time between new position entries.

behavioral_profile._behavioral_constraints_note: User commitment document — not system-enforced. System cannot verify compliance.

cooling_off_requirements._required_actions_note: Human checklist — system cannot verify completion. User acknowledgment only before restart. New strategy generation and new position entries are blocked for cooling_off_days. Existing positions run normal exit logic.

signal_override_policy._note: Ad hoc overrides are the most common source of systematic strategy performance degradation. Policy must be explicit at intake.

behavioral_profile._max_consecutive_losses_note: GOVERNANCE TRIGGER ONLY. Reclassified from v9 hard constraint. Activates mandate review and cooling_off_requirements. Does NOT constrain the Builder's optimization engine or signal thresholds.

tax_and_legal._account_tax_status_note: Tier 1. Directly affects strategy design at the generation level.
tax_and_legal._estimated_marginal_tax_rate_note: Used to weight after-tax returns in strategy evaluation and to flag strategies that are highly tax-inefficient at this user's tax rate.

short_term_gains_tolerance._contradiction_rules: Rule 09: strongly_prefer_to_avoid + all horizon max_days < 365 = warning. Rule 10: estimated_marginal_tax_rate_pct >= 32 + any horizon max_days < 365 + level in [neutral,acceptable,indifferent] = advisory (proactive connection — user may not have connected these facts).

tax_and_legal._legal_trading_restrictions_note: DOCUMENTATION ONLY — NOT ENFORCED BY PIPELINE. Full compliance enforcement (blackout dates, restricted securities lists, pre-clearance) is out of scope for v10. This field captures disclosure for Builder awareness only. User-facing copy must state: 'This field is for disclosure purposes only. Aegis does not enforce blackout periods or restricted securities lists. You are responsible for compliance with your applicable trading policies.' Builder: set filing_notes.legal_restrictions_disclosure_flag = true if this field is populated.

_macro_view_schema._strategy_implication_note: Builder-actionable language — use directly in strategy generation decisions.

governance_and_review._note: New section in v10. Standard in institutional IPS documents. Absent from v9.

review_trigger_conditions._drawdown_review_note: Percentage of max_portfolio_drawdown_pct that triggers review — not the absolute drawdown value. Example: 75 means review triggers when cumulative drawdown reaches 75% of the max limit.

mandate_priority_hierarchy._note: Read before any decision requiring trade-offs between preferences. ordered_priorities ranking determines which preference yields when they conflict. immovable preferences are Tier 2-Hard — inviolable within their pipeline stage (post-Tier-1-filtering) but NOT collapsed into Tier 1 filters. Different pipeline stages.

_ordered_priority_schema._dimension_note: v9 had universe_specificity and strategy_type_adherence. These are replaced in v10 by catalyst_type_adherence and sector_focus. Update drag-to-rank UI component accordingly.

_preference_flexibility_schema._immovable_note: Activates Tier 2-Hard classification for this preference. Builder treats as inviolable within the already-constructed universe. Example: 'no shorting biotech' = immovable → allows long biotech, blocks short biotech. This is NOT the same as sectors_excluded (Tier 1 hard filter that blocks all biotech). These apply at different pipeline stages and must not be collapsed.

filing_notes._note: System-generated entirely. No user input. Produced by two-pass confirmation endpoint. Read LAST, after reading the full schema.

_contradiction_schema._severity_enforcement: blocking: mandate cannot lock until resolved. warning: can proceed; user must acknowledge. advisory: surfaced for awareness only.

volatility_target_derivation._assumed_sharpe_note: Conservative baseline Sharpe for pre-deployment strategies: 0.4-0.6. Updated as live performance data accumulates. Not a static derivation.

filing_notes._open_questions_note: Material gaps where conservative defaults are applied. Each entry names the field and the default being applied.
filing_notes._legal_flag_note: Set to true by Pass 1 if legal_trading_restrictions_disclosure is populated. Builder: flag this in strategy generation output when true.
